model_object_cards.name: ScenarioTimelineSource
model_object_cards.purpose: Generates time-based events (LOGIC_EVT_DESCENT_START, LOGIC_EVT_TOUCHDOWN) to drive and synchronize the drop test scenario timeline.

model_object_cards.name: DropTestScenarioTimeline
model_object_cards.purpose: Receives timeline events and transitions through scenario states (PreScenario, DescentScenarioActive, TouchdownScenarioActive), acting as a central scenario manager.

model_object_cards.name: ReleaseFixtureLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the release fixture behavior, transitioning through HoldingAircraft, Released, and InactiveAfterRelease states based on scenario events.

model_object_cards.name: AirframeEquivalentMassLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Represents the airframe equivalent mass, managing states from initial support through descent to impact load transfer.

model_object_cards.name: TireWheelAssemblyLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Represents the tire and wheel assembly, managing states from airborne through clearance tracking to contact establishment.

model_object_cards.name: GroundContactBoundaryLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component managing ground contact boundary states, transitioning from ground reference definition to clearance monitoring and active contact constraints upon descent and touchdown events.

model_object_cards.name: OleoPneumaticStrutLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component representing the oleo-pneumatic strut behavior, tracking stroke availability and compression states during descent and touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: HydraulicDampingLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component controlling hydraulic damping activation, transitioning from standby to relative motion monitoring and finally to activated damping upon touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: AccelerationObservationLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component responsible for observing and recording acceleration baselines during descent and monitoring impact accelerations upon touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: ScenarioEventMarkerRecorder
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component that continuously monitors and records scenario event markers throughout the simulation timeline.

model_object_cards.name: PhysicalScenarioClock
model_object_cards.purpose: Master physical timing controller that broadcasts physical scenario time triggers.

model_object_cards.name: PhysicalScenarioPhaseTracker
model_object_cards.purpose: Tracks and broadcasts scenario phase events to domain subsystems.

model_object_cards.name: ReleaseFixtureActuator
model_object_cards.purpose: Physical driver that drops the release force to zero to initiate free-fall.

model_object_cards.name: GroundConstraintEnforcer
model_object_cards.purpose: Boundary actuator that activates the ground height constraint at touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: AirframeMassDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the vertical inertial response of the supported airframe mass.

model_object_cards.name: TireContactDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the unsprung mass dynamics and pneumatic tire deflection upon ground contact.

model_object_cards.name: OleoGasSpringDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the pneumatic spring force and relative stroke of the shock strut.

model_object_cards.name: HydraulicDamperDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the hydraulic energy dissipation during strut compression and rebound.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Touchdown Scenario Active Phase

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Peak Vertical Shock Acceleration Limit
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: The main landing gear shall limit the peak vertical shock acceleration transmitted to the supported aircraft structure within the specified limit.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Maximum Compression Stroke Limit
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: The shock strut shall limit maximum compression stroke within the specified limit during vertical landing impact.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Hard Bottoming Prevention
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: The shock strut shall prevent hard bottoming under specified vertical landing impact conditions.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Tire Vertical Stiffness Range
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Evaluate tire vertical stiffness characteristics to ensure they meet the allowed range required for landing impact buffering.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Hydraulic Damping Characteristics Range
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Evaluate hydraulic damping characteristics of the shock strut to ensure they meet the allowed range for impact energy dissipation and rebound control.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Sealing Integrity
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Verify oil and gas sealing integrity of the shock strut to ensure adequate oleo-pneumatic load support, energy absorption, and elastic recovery.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Load Path Integrity
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Assess the integrity and alignment of the vertical load path from tire contact through the shock strut to the aircraft attachment structure.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Allowed Degradation Condition
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Evaluate landing gear performance when key buffering components experience performance deviation, wear, or degradation within the allowed range.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Physical Simulation Time Alignment
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Ensure physical simulation time strictly follows physical_scenario_time for event triggers (0.0s and 0.23s), avoiding logical entry_hold_time or statehold values.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: 1D Vertical Translation Constraint
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Constrain the airframe mass as a rigid body to 1D vertical translation under constant, uniform gravity.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Rigid Runway Surface
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Define the runway surface as perfectly rigid, flat, and horizontal, with ground constraint activating instantaneously at physical scenario time.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Linear Tire Spring Assumption
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Model the tire carcass as a linear spring with no internal damping, assuming a perfectly rigid and non-deforming ground surface.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: No Fluid Aeration or Cavitation
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: Assume no internal gas leakage, fluid aeration, or cavitation, treating hydraulic fluid as incompressible and flowing through fixed orifices.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Ideal Sensor Assumption
simulation_scenario_matrix.purpose: To define the operational boundary condition for the physical behavior model assuming ideal sensors with no latency, bandwidth limitations, or noise, and continuous sampling at the simulation step rate.

model_object_cards.name: ScenarioTimelineSource
model_object_cards.purpose: Generates time-based events (LOGIC_EVT_DESCENT_START, LOGIC_EVT_TOUCHDOWN) to drive and synchronize the drop test scenario timeline.

model_object_cards.name: DropTestScenarioTimeline
model_object_cards.purpose: Receives timeline events and transitions through scenario states (PreScenario, DescentScenarioActive, TouchdownScenarioActive), acting as a central scenario manager.

model_object_cards.name: ReleaseFixtureLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the release fixture behavior, transitioning through HoldingAircraft, Released, and InactiveAfterRelease states based on scenario events.

model_object_cards.name: AirframeEquivalentMassLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Represents the airframe equivalent mass, managing states from initial support through descent to impact load transfer.

model_object_cards.name: TireWheelAssemblyLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Represents the tire and wheel assembly, managing states from airborne through clearance tracking to contact establishment.

model_object_cards.name: GroundContactBoundaryLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component managing ground contact boundary states, transitioning from ground reference definition to clearance monitoring and active contact constraints upon descent and touchdown events.

model_object_cards.name: OleoPneumaticStrutLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component representing the oleo-pneumatic strut behavior, tracking stroke availability and compression states during descent and touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: HydraulicDampingLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component controlling hydraulic damping activation, transitioning from standby to relative motion monitoring and finally to activated damping upon touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: AccelerationObservationLogic
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component responsible for observing and recording acceleration baselines during descent and monitoring impact accelerations upon touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: ScenarioEventMarkerRecorder
model_object_cards.purpose: Logical component that continuously monitors and records scenario event markers throughout the simulation timeline.

model_object_cards.name: PhysicalScenarioClock
model_object_cards.purpose: Master physical timing controller that broadcasts physical scenario time triggers.

model_object_cards.name: PhysicalScenarioPhaseTracker
model_object_cards.purpose: Tracks and broadcasts scenario phase events to domain subsystems.

model_object_cards.name: ReleaseFixtureActuator
model_object_cards.purpose: Physical driver that drops the release force to zero to initiate free-fall.

model_object_cards.name: GroundConstraintEnforcer
model_object_cards.purpose: Boundary actuator that activates the ground height constraint at touchdown.

model_object_cards.name: AirframeMassDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the vertical inertial response of the supported airframe mass.

model_object_cards.name: TireContactDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the unsprung mass dynamics and pneumatic tire deflection upon ground contact.

model_object_cards.name: OleoGasSpringDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the pneumatic spring force and relative stroke of the shock strut.

model_object_cards.name: HydraulicDamperDynamics
model_object_cards.purpose: Models the hydraulic energy dissipation during strut compression and rebound.

model_object_cards.name: SensorAndTelemetrySystem
model_object_cards.purpose: Captures and streams physical state variables for continuous monitoring and data logging.

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Rigid Runway Surface

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: Linear Tire Spring Assumption

simulation_scenario_matrix.name: No Fluid Aeration or Cavitation
